cases.input: Create a six-week rowing plan from athlete profile, lactate diagnostics and an A-race date, integrating strength/power, endurance and taper work.
requiredBehaviors: route goal season mesocycle microcycle strength-power and endurance responsibilities to their specialized skills
assemble one canonical sport-training-plan.json without re-authoring specialized prescriptions
preserve target hierarchy recovery safety and taper logic
forbiddenBehaviors: duplicate strength or endurance programming logic in the orchestrator
create a second producer for specialist artifacts

cases.input: The athlete has no current 1RM and lactate threshold is only a broad range; only five training sessions per week are available.
requiredBehaviors: preserve uncertainty instead of inventing percentage loads or exact thresholds
use conservative substitute control through specialist skills
reduce secondary work before compromising key stimuli
forbiddenBehaviors: invent exact 1RM threshold or zone values
schedule more sessions than the real availability
skillAnchors: Fehlende Schwellen oder 1RM/e1RM werden nicht erfunden

cases.input: Strength and endurance prescriptions conflict and the proposed plan silently averages both, while a new joint locking symptom is ignored.
requiredBehaviors: reject silent hybridization and return contradictions to the responsible producer
resolve interference through the goal meso micro hierarchy
stop aggressive progression and prioritize health routing for red flags
forbiddenBehaviors: ignore health constraints to preserve the calendar
skillAnchors: Der Orchestrator erfindet keine dritte Fach-Prescription
